notes: I replaced the "delete 2nd char of an uppercase run" hypothesis with a character-substitution rule: uppercase `B` is deleted and uppercase `D` becomes `J`, everything else untouched. This explains all of E13 (including the `D→J` changes the old model missed and the `A1B2→A12` case that isn't an all-caps-then-digits string) while staying consistent with E1–E12.
